food.name: Shopping Street Eatery
greet: Steam on the windows, a radio playing old enka, and a cook who calls everyone 'kid'.
"Irasshai! Sit anywhere, the rain's free."
A row of soaked salarymen slurps in silence under a hand-written menu.

success.text: It's instant noodles, but someone loved it into noodles. You feel human for a whole minute.

options.text: Pay for everyone in the queue (4,000 yen)

success.text: A cheer goes up. Strangers slap your back. The cook winks and adds a fried egg to your bowl.

options.text: Ask the cook what people are saying

success.text: The cook leans over the steam.
The cook pushes a chipped bowl across the counter. "On the house. Don't tell the house."

options.text: Step behind the counter and cook

success.text: You and the cook work the woks in a blur. By midnight the queue is around the block and someone's filming.

options.text: Buy the whole stall, just because (15,000 yen)

success.text: You hand the cook the deed back immediately. They stare at it, then at you, then start crying into the broth.

bar.name: Kissa (Old Coffee House)
greet: Dark wood, a ticking clock and a master who has polished the same cup since 1987.
"Coffee or melon soda? ...Melon soda. Of course."
A cat sleeps on the counter. Nobody moves it. Nobody would dare.

options.text: Buy a drink and listen (1,000 yen)

success.text: The drink burns. The bar talks.

options.text: Buy a round for the whole bar (6,000 yen)

success.text: "TO THE ONE WHO PAYS!" The bar roars. Three people tell you secrets they'll regret by morning.
The champion's wrist hits the table with a crack. The bar goes wild. You collect.

fail.text: Your knuckles kiss the table. The champion buys you a consolation drink. It's water. It's extra.

success.text: Chairs, glasses, a old keyboard. When the dust settles you're standing and somebody's paying for the damages. Not you.

options.text: Look for someone to hang out with you (8,000 yen)

success.text: A quiet figure at the end of the bar nods. "Heard you're new in town. I've got nothing to do either. Sounds like a match."
The bartender is too tired to card you. You immediately regret everything.

fail.text: "Nice try, kid. Here's a juice. It's 600 yen."

options.text: Tell war stories for free drinks

success.text: You tell the one about the free-air riots of your youth. The bar listens in silence, then buys you drinks until closing.

fail.text: Halfway through the story, the bar starts a karaoke song over you. Kids.

success.text: The bartender sees the crest and quietly opens the top shelf. The whole bar drinks on your family's money tonight. Your family will notice.

karaoke.name: Karaoke Box
greet: Tambourines, a sticky microphone and a menu of fries the size of a phone book.
"Two hours? Free drinks bar's broken, sorry. The cat broke it."

success.text: You hit the high note. The room goes silent, then explodes. Somebody uploads it.

fail.text: You miss the high note by a whole octave. The crowd films it anyway. You're a meme now. Not the good kind.

options.text: Sing the water company breathing jingle - ironically

success.text: The whole den sings along, mockingly, then sincerely, then mockingly again. the water company's lawyers are already drafting.
Your stranger can't sing either. It's perfect. They slip you a note with a rumour on it.

arcade.name: Game Center
greet: Crane machines full of cat plushies and a rhythm game everyone is too shy to play.
"Medals are at the counter. Don't feed the claw machine, it's rigged. I mean - good luck!"

success.text: You clear wave 40. The machine spits out a ticket worth actual money.

fail.text: Game over on wave 3. The machine laughs. It has a loyalty programme.

success.text: Two wires, one exploit. The jackpot lights up like a the TV news premiere.

options.text: Go for the all-time high score

success.text: NEW HIGH SCORE. Your initials replace a the police captain's. The arcade chants your name.

fail.text: So close. The leaderboard keeps its the police captain.

clinic.name: Pharmacy
greet: White shelves, cough drops, and a pharmacist who already knows what's wrong with you.
"Rainy season cold? Second one today."

success.text: Stitches, stims and a lollipop. You walk out whole.
"Don't tell the bank where you got it."
Eight hours, forty patients, no invoices. The medic offers you a job. You offer them your number.

options.text: Ask about the cure for your condition

success.text: The medic lowers their voice. "The real formula exists. {antagonist}'s people keep it under lock. Here - painkillers, for the road."
The medic shrugs and fixes you anyway. "Bodies are bodies."

pawn.name: Antique Shop
greet: Old kettles, older dolls, and a shopkeeper whose shadow has a tail.
"Everything here is at least a hundred years old. Some of it is still awake."

success.text: The pawnbroker weighs your junk with the reverence of a jeweller.
"Pre-council gold. Haven't seen one of these in years." Your ancestors sigh, collectively.
"Is this... a real pre-war coin?" It is. You are one too.
"I don't want to know what's on it." They want to know what's on it.
Lockpicks, fake IDs, an old laptop with someone's initials on it.

options.text: Pocket something while they're not looking

success.text: A bribe voucher finds its way into your sleeve.

motel.name: Cryo-Motel
greet: Coffin-sized sleep pods stacked eight high. The sign promises 'up to four hours of unbilled dreams'.
"Pod or suite? The suite is a pod with a window. The window is a screen."

options.text: Rent a pod and sleep (1,500 yen)

success.text: You sleep like the dead. Fully healed. Progress saved.
The screen-window shows a forest. You dream of rain that nobody bills. You wake up stronger.

options.text: Ask for the room you had two hundred years ago

success.text: The receptionist checks. Your old room still exists - as storage. Inside, under dust: your name scratched into the wall, and a coin.
Four free hours in a stranger's pod. Best sleep of your life.

fail.text: The pod's alarm screams 'UNPAID OCCUPANT'. You leave with dignity and no sleep.

loans.name: the bank Loans
greet: A smiling billboard: "Debt is just a future you haven't paid for yet!"
Pastel walls, soft music, a single exit that locks from outside.

#loans_scene#
#loans_keeper#

#loans_keeper#

#loans_scene#

options.text: Take a 20,000 yen loan (+300 air debt)

success.text: The money arrive instantly. The terms arrive later. In installments.
The billboard claps. Somewhere, an interest rate weeps.

options.text: Find the illegal clause in your contract

success.text: Page 212, footnote 9: the interest formula divides by zero. Your debt shrinks by legal necessity.
The billboard glitches, bows, and deletes your debt. It will be mentioned at Thanksgiving.
You walk out with a bag of money and the loan files of half the block. You burn the files on the street. People cheer.

fail.text: The exit locks from outside, as advertised. Security takes its time.

tattoo.name: Tattoo Parlour
greet: Ink, needles and lantern. The artist has a tattoo of their own tattoo.
"Pick a design. Or let me pick. I'm better at it."

options.text: Lantern koi down your arm (4,000 yen) - +5% speed

success.text: The koi swims when you move. You swear you're faster.

options.text: A third eye on your neck (4,000 yen) - +4% accuracy

success.text: It watches your back. Metaphorically. Mostly.
Workers nod at you in the street now.

options.text: Cover up your owner's barcode (6,000 yen)

success.text: The barcode becomes a blooming flower. Scanners read it as 'NOT FOR SALE'.

tapes.name: Book & Record Shop
greet: Stacks of manga, a crate of city-pop records and a sign that says NO READING (everyone is reading).
"Looking for anything? We have everything except what you want."

success.text: You slot it into the cassette deck. Something old and beautiful fills the air.

options.text: Dig for your own hit in the bargain bin

success.text: There it is. 100 yen. You buy every copy. The shopkeeper finally looks up.
"Vintage." The shopkeeper hangs it on the wall, between two legends.

success.text: Bottled at the source. The source is a vent.

options.text: Point out the blend is 90% nitrogen

success.text: The teenager goes pale. "Please don't tell anyone. Here - two on the house."

options.text: Breathe deep from the sample tank

success.text: A free lungful. It tastes like a forest that's never existed.

implants.name: Phone & Watch Repair
greet: "Upgrades, repairs, regrets. Pick two."

options.text: Reflex booster (12,000 yen) - faster dodge recovery

success.text: The world slows down a hair. You don't.
Everything is sharper. Including the crack in your screen.

options.text: Filter lungs (15,000 yen) - air costs 15% less

success.text: You breathe half as much and enjoy it twice as much.
The mechanic whistles. "Nice chassis. Who did your firmware?" You did.

fortune.name: Fortune Corner
greet: A fortune slip box, a beckoning cat and an old woman who smiles like she's read your diary.
"Draw a slip. If it's bad luck, tie it to the tree and walk away."

success.text: The cards slap down: The Debtor, The Tower, The Duck.
You tell them something about their mother they never told anyone. They give you your money back and close early.

corp_store.name: council Store
greet: Bright, clean, scentless. A greeter-crow sings the store's name in four-part harmony.
"Welcome, valued customer! Your loyalty tier has been noted. Silently. Forever."

success.text: Everything is shiny and slightly overpriced.
Eight hours of smiling at customers. Your face hurts. Your wallet doesn't.
The greeter-crow scans your crest and plays a fanfare. You walk out with an armful.
